name: Universal Plastic Mold UPM, Inc.
old_description: For more than 60 years, Universal Plastic Mold has been a leading manufacturer of high tonnage custom and large part injection molding thanks to our one-stop facility. We want to provide a single, convenient source for your injection molding needs. Thanks to our diverse array of plastic injection molding equipment, our company can handle all of your plastic injection molding needs. We’ve mastered putting together a complete plastics manufacturing strategy, and our goal is to go far beyond making plastics.
about:
Universal Plastic Mold (UPM) is a family-owned custom plastic injection molder founded in 1962 in Baldwin Park, California. The company has operated continuously under family ownership, with second-generation leadership in place since 2007.

UPM operates 30 injection molding machines ranging from 150 to 2,000 tons, including five presses at 1,500+ tons and three at 2,000 tons, in a single ~130,000 sq ft facility. The company provides full turnkey scope — molding, finishing (painting, silk-screening, hot-stamping), complex assembly, PCB integration, kitting, packaging, and distribution — under one ISO 9001:2015 quality system. Approximately 300 employees and $30M+ annual revenue.

UPM serves mid-market OEMs in automotive, specialty vehicles, industrial, high-end electronics, medical and laboratory equipment, and packaging, with selective consumer goods and hardware work. Customers include OEMs running hard-tooled production programs with minimum economic runs of 500 pieces per release through annual volumes in the millions.

The company emphasizes single point of accountability — the Account Manager and Program Manager are the same person — a 24-hour email reply standard, and published performance metrics (99.33% on-time delivery, 5.4 DPMO, 98% customer retention). Domestic production keeps customer-owned tooling under U.S. jurisdiction, and first-pass DFM is provided at no additional cost.
